purpose: Define server-authoritative personal augmentation-core rewards for boss content while preserving original boss rewards.

reward_bands.intent: A real boss is a reliable route into rare/epic progression.
Major bosses are a direct route into epic/legendary progression.
Pinnacle bosses make mythic cores possible without making repeated mythic farming routine.

sources.content_summary: Dedicated time-themed dimension with six authored bosses.
sources.assignment_policy: start major; move individual bosses to standard or pinnacle after measured gameplay difficulty

sources.content_summary: World shrines, raid caches, a boss dimension, and eleven major boss encounters in the current 2.0.2 content set.
sources.integration_method: augmentation-side server death/entity adapter and optional loot/cache injection
sources.assignment_policy: only bosses proven to be final-tier encounters are promoted to boss_pinnacle

sources.content_summary: Repeatable generated endgame dungeons with dungeon bosses and a pinnacle Beastweaver boss event.
sources.known_major_boss_count: repeatable dungeon boss pool plus Beastweaver
sources.integration_method: augmentation-side server boss adapter; source hook is permitted if required
sources.repeat_policy: repeatable pinnacle encounters use reduced direct mythic weights

global_rules.participant_eligibility: server-side encounter participation contract to be implemented; do not use shared ground-drop ownership
